name: DaCheng Alpha
summary: DaCheng Alpha is a small humanoid companion and learning robot from Chengqing Robotics. Its articulated body has a head, two arms and two legs. The manufacturer lists 13 degrees of freedom, ROS2, binocular cameras, voice interaction and mobile-app control, and positions it for learners aged 3–15. The official website presents a preorder entry, but current shipping availability is unverified.
